title: Structural MRI quality classification from IQMs
current_best_explanation: No current global winner has been verified on this exact frozen input, split and scorer. A published dataset name or broad leaderboard lead is insufficient.
executed_endpoint: Processed structural MRIQC table: 68 IQMs; ABIDE 600 training scans, DS030 265 test scans. Rater1 exclusion target; doubtful merged with accept; balanced accuracy. Raw MRI images are unavailable to fitted methods.

existing_reference.name: Fixed balanced RF500 and archived original MRIQC classifier
existing_reference.evidence: A: locally evaluated outputs; archived fitting provenance differs.
existing_reference.strength: Original MRIQC RF is historically and operationally relevant.
problems: Archived rater-collapse and tuning history need separate treatment.
A modern MRIQC release is an extractor, not evidence for a new classifier winner.
Scanner/site/rater shift may dominate apparent classifier differences.
existing_reference.verification_scope: Only the named locally audited reference/archived outputs, not every newer candidate or equal-budget/global optimality.

candidates.name: Archived original MRIQC classifier, locally rescored
candidates.evidence: B/A: established primary pipeline; local archived reference exists.
candidates.information_match: Archived outputs are locally measured, with differing historical training/rater conventions. A canonical-label refit is a separate unexecuted candidate.

candidates.name: TabPFN-3.5
candidates.information_match: 68-feature input fits; local weights/license and training-only calibration must be fixed; no target-site adaptation.

candidates.name: TabICLv2
candidates.information_match: Can consume IQMs; matched ABIDE→DS030 result not established.

candidates.name: MI-DQA IQM-only branch
candidates.evidence: C: author-repository claim, peer-reviewed matched evidence unverified.
candidates.information_match: Only IQM branch could fit; full fusion uses raw image features unavailable here and source labels/splits may differ.

candidates.name: FetMRQC
candidates.evidence: B for fetal imaging; D for endpoint compatibility.
candidates.information_match: Fetal T2-weighted QA differs in anatomy, modality, IQM construction and labels; do not transfer its rank.

recommended_next_comparator: Refit a documented MRIQC-style site-aware RF/boosted-tree panel using training scans only, then add locally run TabICLv2 or TabPFN-3.5 with identical labels/features.
switching_assessment: RETAIN original MRIQC as a historical specialist and ADD modern IQM-only comparators, Tier B. Do not replace with raw-image QC or a fetal model, and do not elevate an unverified repository table to current SOTA.
limitations: Precomputed IQMs limit what image-foundation models can do.
No matched current public leaderboard identified for these 68 columns and rater1 label collapse.
MI-DQA publication date and independent evaluation are unresolved; repository self-description is weaker evidence.
TabPFN weights have separate terms; no data upload or weights accepted during this review.

evidence_tiers.A: Locally executed and audited on this frozen protocol; establishes a comparator result, not universal optimality.
evidence_tiers.B: Primary method/benchmark with relevant task evidence but an unmatched split, inputs, scorer or budget.
evidence_tiers.C: Author repository, preprint, mathematical proposal or adaptation requiring additional validation.
evidence_tiers.D: Unresolved access, unavailable artifacts or input mismatch precludes an executable recommendation.

execution_policy: Literature review only. No inference, fitting, new scores, checkpoint downloads, frozen protocol edits or result changes. Any new comparator requires a prospective amendment, frozen training-only selection and separate result records.
score_import_policy: No unmatched published numbers were imported into benchmark scores.
